reason: I literally missed a deadline last sem because nobody texted me in time, so a free app that pings me before stuff is due is worth having. I'd install it, but if it skips even one notice I'm back to asking friends at 11pm.
objection: Will it actually catch everything? If professors post stuff on WhatsApp or say it in class and it never gets on the app, the alerts are useless and I'll stop trusting it.
would_change_my_mind: If it missed one real deadline that my friends knew about, I'd stop opening it.
